digest.title: New 'BlueMoon' kit exploited Windows and Chrome zero-day flaws
digest.tldr: Multiple cyber-espionage groups deployed an exploit kit dubbed "BlueMoon" that leveraged zero-day vulnerabilities in Microsoft Windows and Google Chrome.

digest.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
digest.tldr: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.
